documentation.description:
Radio_Kit.Protocol.Channels

In-Band Sub-Frequency Channel Plan & Frequency Sets.
Provides user-selectable frequency tiers (LOW_FREQ, MEDIUM_LOW_FREQ, MEDIUM_FREQ,
HIGH_FREQ, VERY_HIGH_FREQ) where all sub-frequencies (Discovery, ACK, Data 1..8)
are strictly grouped within a single narrow band for single-antenna resonance.

enumeration_literals.name: Role_Discovery
enumeration_literals.description: Network beacons, neighbor discovery, and connection requests

enumeration_literals.name: Role_ACK
enumeration_literals.description: Fast ACKs, control frames, and flow control

enumeration_literals.name: Role_Data
enumeration_literals.description: Dedicated traffic channels for payload communication

simple_types.name: Frequency_Set
simple_types.code:
type Frequency_Set is
  (LOW_FREQ,
   MEDIUM_LOW_FREQ,
   MEDIUM_FREQ,
   HIGH_FREQ,
   VERY_HIGH_FREQ);

enumeration_literals.name: LOW_FREQ
enumeration_literals.description: ~475 kHz (LF/MF groundwave / ferrite rod / long wire)

enumeration_literals.name: MEDIUM_FREQ
enumeration_literals.description: ~13.560 MHz (22m ISM / magnetic loop / PCB trace)

enumeration_literals.name: HIGH_FREQ
enumeration_literals.description: ~27.120 MHz (11m ISM default / 27 MHz rubber ducky whip)

enumeration_literals.name: VERY_HIGH_FREQ
enumeration_literals.description: ~45.000 MHz (SYS/2 pure integer clock / short whip)

simple_types.name: Predefined_Channel
simple_types.code:
type Predefined_Channel is
  (Channel_Discovery_27_120_kHz,
   Channel_ACK_27_145_kHz,
   Channel_Data_1_26_965_kHz,
   Channel_Data_2_26_990_kHz,
   Channel_Data_3_27_015_kHz,
   Channel_Data_4_27_040_kHz,
   Channel_Data_5_27_065_kHz,
   Channel_Data_6_27_170_kHz,
   Channel_Data_7_27_195_kHz,
   Channel_Data_8_27_220_kHz);

subprograms.name: ACK_Frequency
subprograms.code:
function ACK_Frequency
  (Set : Frequency_Set := HIGH_FREQ) return Types.Frequency_Range

subprograms.name: Data_Frequency
Discovery_Frequency
subprograms.code:
function Discovery_Frequency
  (Set : Frequency_Set := HIGH_FREQ) return Types.Frequency_Range
